events.title: Demo Patch Notes - PvP Emojis & Priest Desync Fix (2026.10.19)
events.summary: Friend Duel (PvP) Update Notes (2026.10.19) ■ New Feature: PvP Emojis - \You can now send emojis while planning your move to interact with your opponent. Try using emojis in various ways. - \Selected emojis bounce and appear above your character's head in real time. ■ PvP Priest Sync Fix - \Fixed an issue in PvP where Priest's mood status and poison recovery checks were out of sync between both players.

events.title: Demo Patch Notes - Friend Duel (PvP) Mode Update (2026.10.12)
events.summary: Friend Duel (PvP) Update Notes (2026.10.12) ■ New Mode: Friend Duel (PvP) - \ Click "Friend Duel" on the title screen to create a room, share the code with your friend, and jump right into a 1v1 match! - \ Once in the lobby, you have 20 seconds to choose your character and allocate stats. Any remaining points will be distributed automatically when time runs out! - \ Each turn has a 10-second limit during battle. Running out of time inflicts a 2 HP penalty, so make bold and quick choices! - \ Aft

events.title: Demo Patch Notes - Control Fixes & QoL Improvements (2026.08.22)
events.summary: Demo Patch Notes (2026.08.22)- Fixed Keyboard/Gamepad UI Controls: Resolved issues where dropdown menus were unresponsive and tab switching behaved erratically when navigating with a keyboard or gamepad, improving overall navigation stability.- Improved AI Logic Viewer: Enhanced tooltip responsiveness and font readability for enemy AI logic slots. You can now click on any logic slot to view all assigned logic in that row at once.- Character Balance Adjustments: * Warrior (Ryun): Base HP adjusted

events.title: Demo Patch Notes - Keyboard Control Support & QoL Improvements (2026.08.20)
events.summary: Demo Patch Notes (2026.08.20)- Keyboard Controls Support: In addition to mouse controls, you can now navigate using the Arrow Keys and make selections with the Spacebar.- Hotkeys & Scroll Navigation: Play more seamlessly with dedicated hotkeys for hand choices (1–4), skills (Q–R), the menu (ESC), and page scrolling (PgUp / PgDn).- Control Guide UI: Added intuitive guide badges on buttons and scrollable areas when navigating with the keyboard.

events.title: Demo Version Patch Notes - AI Logic & Stability Improvements (2026.08.19)
events.summary: Demo Version Patch Notes:Fixed AI "Mind Reading" Bug: Fixed an unfair issue where the AI could read the player's input even if the turn was skipped and no hand was actually played on the table.
